etsy.title: Photography Wrapping Paper, Camera Lover Gift Wrap, Photographer Birthday, Dark Minimalist Icons
etsy.description:
Photography wrapping paper featuring minimalist camera, aperture, and focus icons in a warm orange tiled pattern on a dark zinc background, perfect for wrapping gifts for the photographer in your life.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• Physical wrapping paper printed on 90gsm fine art paper, shipped directly to you
• Available in three sizes: 30×36″ (single sheet), 30×72″ (roll), and 30×180″ (large roll)
• Choose matte or glossy finish
• Dark zinc background (#18181B) with warm orange photography icons (#FB923C) in a repeating tile pattern

HOW TO USE
Wrap birthday, holiday, or graduation gifts for any photographer, camera enthusiast, or photography student. The dark background with bold orange icons makes every package stand out.

This listing is a physical product, not a digital download. The paper is recyclable. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Vintage camera illustrations on cream or beige backgrounds dominate; minimalist icon-based designs on dark backgrounds are very rare.
Most listings use muted brown, beige, or black-and-white palettes; a warm orange on dark zinc would stand out.
Competitor titles lead with 'Photography Wrapping Paper' or 'Camera Gift Wrap' and add audience terms like 'photographer', 'filmography', 'shutterbug'.
Physical wrapping paper prices range from about $8 to $35 depending on size and seller.
Amazon titles use 'Camera Photography Photographer' as a keyword cluster, followed by 'Premium Kraft Gift Wrap'.
Vintage camera designs dominate Amazon as well; Cavallini's Italian archival paper is a premium option at 20x28 inches.
Multi-sheet sets and custom photo wraps are common on Amazon; roll formats like ours are less represented.

research.notes: Primary keyword 'photography wrapping paper' chosen because Etsy has indexed it as a market page and it directly matches buyer intent for this product category. The phrase appears in competitor listing titles and search results. Our product differentiates with a modern minimalist icon approach (camera, aperture, focus symbols) on a dark zinc background with warm orange, which is visually distinct from the vintage camera illustrations on light backgrounds that dominate the market.
